verdict.rationale: Swell's first-party docs describe webhooks that call a configured URL when a particular event occurs. They can subscribe to any number of model events, which gives programmatic consumers registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. missing for 10: an event catalog or list of supported event types, payload format, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks can be configured to call a URL when a particular event occurs, enabling outgoing calls to external services.
Webhooks enable real-time communication between the Swell platform and external services, by subscribing to any number of model events.
